run_proto_builder_tests: run the unittest test suite for google.protobuf.proto_builder to verify proto class creation
test_MakeSimpleProtoClass: test creating a protobuf message class dynamically from a fields dictionary and full_name
test_ordered_fields: test that field order is preserved when passing an OrderedDict to MakeSimpleProtoClass
test_descriptor_pool_reuse: test that creating the same proto class twice with a shared DescriptorPool returns the same descriptor
review_ProtoBuilderTest: review the ProtoBuilderTest class and its three test methods for proto_builder functionality
